description: Aider-polyglot style (Python): implement a fixed-width multi-currency ledger printer from a stub and an instructions file - locale-dependent symbol placement and separators, negative amounts in parentheses with alignment padding for positives, description truncation at exactly 24 characters, and a three-key sort. The unit tests carry the edge cases a first attempt usually misses (24 vs 25 character boundary, small amounts, case-sensitive ordering) and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
